subtitle: Stoa yoga & rest, offline
promotional_text: Walk yoga, breath, and sleep in this phone, plus a private journal — fully offline. No account. No cloud.
description: Pewter Stoa is a personal wellness learning system that teaches yoga, breathing, mindfulness, meditation, relaxation, flexibility, and steady daily routines - privately, on your device. After you install the app, it keeps working with Airplane Mode on. There is no account, no login, no cloud sync, and no remote AI. It is not just a meditation timer. You get a colonnade of practice you can walk without a subscription or a signal: personalized sessions, breathing, sleep, and a private journal — fully offline. No account. No cloud. Stoa is an on-device teacher that picks a session from your aspect, minutes, grain, hour, and recent practice. Timed yoga and mobility sequences come with teaching cues. Breath walks use four rising columns. Night practices are written for bed. Pose bays offer short lessons. Tablet is a private journal — fully offline. There is no account, no login, no cloud sync, and no remote AI. Sessions ship inside the app. Journal, preferences, and logs live in local storage.
app_review_notes: Pewter Stoa is a complete offline yoga and meditation teacher. Complete onboarding, walk the session on Walk, run Four columns (rising-column breath), open Range, and save a Tablet note. There is no account, no login, no cloud sync, and no remote AI. Private journal — fully offline. No account. No cloud.
